headline: KLA Falls After Earnings: Raised Guidance Fails To Impress Wall Street
summary: KLAC stock tanks after Q4 report. Needham keeps buy rating with $270 PT, Cantor Fitzgerald reiterates overweight rating with $325 PT.

headline: Oil Spikes 7%, Nasdaq 100 Sinks Before Fed: Stock Market Today
summary: Crude surges 7% as Trump vows strikes on Iran and stocks slide ahead of the Fed's decision, with earnings crushing Parsons, Lennox, Watsco and Vertiv.
